evidence: Modifies core wallet files, extracting migration logic from wallet/wallet.cpp into wallet/migration.cpp and updating wallet headers.
rationale: Extracts over 800 lines of legacy migration logic out of wallet.cpp into dedicated files to improve maintainability. The PR author notes that 'wallet/wallet.cpp file is quite hard to reason about... currently more than 4500 lines long' and this move 'paves the way for it being descriptor specific'. While this is a clean code reorganization with no direct user-facing bug fix or feature, it meaningfully reduces complexity in the primary wallet implementation.
